## Harmonised European Standards

[List harmonised European standards (hENs) applied, if available. As of 2026, CRA-specific hENs are being developed by CEN/CENELEC.]

::: {.callout-note}
## Presumption of Conformity

Products manufactured in conformity with harmonised standards benefit from a presumption of conformity with the essential requirements covered by those standards (CRA Article 21).
:::
